overview.text: The Mexican Bullsnake (Mexican Pine Snake) is a large, harmless snake found only in Mexico.

identification.text: Yellowish tan with large, squarish dark brown to black blotches and smaller dark side spots; yellowish belly with square brown spots.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Up to 1.69 m long, including an 18 cm tail.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Central and northern Mexico, from Sonora and Coahuila south to Oaxaca and Puebla.

habitat.text: Forest, shrubland and grassland, and also farms, suburbs and towns.

recognise.text: Big square dark blotches on a yellowish-tan body.
